name: DCA Fiddler, Fifer & Practical Cafe (Buena Vista Street) Turkey Sandwich, Egg Bites, Oatmeal & Cinnamon Roll
brandOrRestaurant: Fiddler, Fifer & Practical Cafe (Buena Vista Street · Disney California Adventure)
whyItWorks: DCA's Buena Vista Street café serves Starbucks Sous-Vide Bacon & Gruyère Egg Bites, Classic Rolled Oatmeal, Butter Croissants, Bananas, and deli Turkey/Ham sandwiches.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Grab Bacon & Gruyère Egg Bites (naturally lactose-safe aged Gruyère), plain Oatmeal (no nut packet), or a Butter Croissant.
watchOuts: Discard the mixed-nut packet from the oatmeal and avoid citrus refreshers
